text.description_html:
Fusion PH-T7, American Relic Series Blue Ridge Toilet Tissue Wall Mount

With its rustic style and beautiful, vintage-looking finishes, the Blue Ridge Toilet Paper Holder is perfect for cabins located in the mountain range after which it is named. But this rural-inspired toilet tissue holder is not only at home in the deep woods, as part of Fusion's American Relic Bath Accessory Line, its quint elegance is great for period-styled homes anywhere. It is easy to install and comes with all the necessary hardware. This PH-T7 Single Post Paper Holder is available in antique relic pewter, medium relic bronze, and dark rustic bronze finishes.

Also Available Matching: Fusion TR-T7 Blue Ridge Towel Ring, Fusion TB-T7 Blue Ridge Towel Bar, and Fusion RH-T7 Blue Ridge Robe Hook

Features and Specifications of the Fusion Blue Ridge Trim Paper Holder:

  • Mount Width: 2-3/4"
  • Mount Length: 4-1/4"
  • Reversible to hang in either direction.
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
